audit.why: Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon, agreed across both layers. It reads oddly against the prose (which gives Pantheon levels 1-3 outright and Sion the item stages), but I have no independent basis to overrule it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the item-stage spikes described the wrong abilities ('W shield-break AOE', 'his E poke').
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s, Soul Furnace 15/14/13/12/11s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s at 800 range, Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s. Soul Furnace is the shield; Roar of the Slayer is the armour shred. The page had them crossed.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer's 12s and 800 range written into mid; Soul Furnace named as the shield in spikes[3], whys[5] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'hold your E to face his charging Q — the directional block makes you untargetable to it and denies the knockup entirely'. This is false and it is the most dangerous line in the entry.
audit.why: Riot describes Aegis Assault as becoming invulnerable to DAMAGE from the front. It is a channel. A fully charged Decimating Smash knocks up and stuns — crowd control, not damage — so it ends the channel rather than being denied by it. The page instructs the player to hold E precisely into the one thing that breaks it, and repeats the instruction in whys[2], spikes[1] and wants.you[1].
audit.corrected: Reversed everywhere: step out of the charged swing; never hold the channel into a knock-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'his shield-break E' and 'E negates his shield-break E' — Roar of the Slayer neither shields nor breaks shields.
audit.why: Riot: Roar of the Slayer 'fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back.' The armour reduction is the interaction that matters against a lethality Pantheon, and it was never mentioned. The shield is Soul Furnace (W), which detonates three seconds after cast.
audit.corrected: Roar of the Slayer named with its armour shred and its minion knock-back; Soul Furnace named as the shield with its 3-second detonation.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glory in Death is referenced only as 'his zombie passive' and its healing is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot: after being killed Sion reanimates with rapid attacks that heal him and deal bonus damage based on the target's maximum health. Standing next to a freshly killed Sion is how a Pantheon dies after winning the fight, and his max-health damage means your own HP items make it worse.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright', plus 'your passive-empowered W stun' in early.
audit.why: Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will, which empowers his next spell — there is no passive shield, and the empowerment is not tied to W specifically.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in phases[0].why, breakdown.early and early.

edits.before: Level 1-3 is all yours. Your passive-empowered W stun is point-and-click — Sion has no dash and a slow, telegraphed Q, so you pick when to all-in. Poke with held long-range Q while he last-hits, then at 2-3 commit W-stun into empowered Q. Crucial detail: hold your E to face his charging Q — the directional block makes you untargetable to it and denies the knockup entirely, and you can even cancel his channel by stunning him out of it. Don't let him land a fully-charged Q on you when your E is down.
edits.after: Level 1-3 is all yours. Mortal Will empowers your next cast every few spells and Shield Vault is point-and-click — Sion has no dash and Decimating Smash is a slow, telegraphed charge, so you pick when to all-in. Poke with the thrown Comet Spear while he last-hits, then at 2-3 commit W-stun into empowered Q. Crucial detail, and the opposite of what most players do: Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front, it does not stop crowd control, so a fully charged knock-up ends the channel. Step out of the swing rather than shielding into it.

edits.before: Through 4-5 you still control the lane — empowered Q poke chunks him and E eats his E shield-break and Q charge. But understand what you're racing: Sion just wants to farm and live, and a Bami's/tank item turns your burst into a dent. At 6 your R is for roaming, not soloing a tank — use Grand Starfall to crash other lanes and snowball the map while you're still the stronger champ. Don't tunnel on killing a Sion who's happy to die and zombie-farm under tower.
edits.after: Through 4-5 you still control the lane — empowered Comet Spear chunks him — but understand what you are racing: Sion wants to farm and live, and a Bami's or tank item turns your burst into a dent. Watch Roar of the Slayer (E, 12s at rank 1, 800 range): it slows you and strips your armour, and it knocks minions back through you. At 6 your R is for roaming, not soloing a tank — crash other lanes while you are still the stronger champion.

edits.before: This is where Sion takes over and you must accept it. By 2+ items he's a full tank — his Q knockup and W shield-into-AOE shrug off your plateaued damage, and his percent-impact teamfight presence dwarfs your dueling. You cannot 1v1 him anymore. Your only path is the lead you built levels 1-6: be ahead in items, splitpush side lanes he can't answer, and use R to make picks elsewhere. If the game went even into 2 items, you've already lost the scaling race — group and let your carries deal with the wall.
edits.after: This is where Sion takes over and you must accept it. By 2+ items he is a full tank — Soul Furnace shields him and detonates three seconds later, Roar of the Slayer shaves your armour before every trade, and his teamfight presence dwarfs your dueling. You cannot 1v1 him anymore. Your only path is the lead you built levels 1-6: be ahead in items, splitpush side lanes he cannot answer, and use R to make picks elsewhere. And when he dies, walk away — Glory in Death heals him off max-health hits.

edits.before: Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright. Identify how Sion contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers your next cast and Comet Spear out-pokes a champion with no dash at all at level 1 here.

edits.before: Passive shield + Q poke wins level 1 outright. Respect Sion's Decimating Smash completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Mortal Will plus Comet Spear wins level 1 outright. Respect the charged Decimating Smash — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.

notes: The dangerous error here is a positive instruction that gets the player killed: 'hold your E to face his charging Q — the directional block makes you untargetable to it and denies the knockup entirely', repeated in whys[2], spikes[1] and wants.you[1]. Aegis Assault is invulnerability to damage from the front, on a channel. A fully charged Decimating Smash applies a knock-up and a stun, which is CC rather than damage, so it cancels the channel instead of being denied by it. Every instance is now reversed to 'step out of the swing'. Second, the entry has Sion's W and E crossed: it calls E a 'shield-break' twice, when Roar of the Slayer is a shockwave that slows and REDUCES ARMOUR (a real problem for a lethality build, and never mentioned) and Soul Furnace is the shield that detonates three seconds after cast. NOT ASSERTED, left alone: the existing claim that you 'can even cancel his channel by stunning him out of it' — Decimating Smash carries no channel flag in the kit and I could not confirm whether a stun interrupts a charge, so I dropped the clause rather than restating it. Also not asserted: Unstoppable Onslaught's name strongly implies CC immunity during the charge, but nothing in Riot's description says so, so I wrote nothing about whether Shield Vault stops it — that is worth a human answer, because it decides whether Pantheon holds W for the ult or not.
